answer: Behavioral Ridge Lock: each identity must sustain a 30-day interaction ridge, and any new registration must show a delta of at least 12 distinct peer-nodes in its prior week. The enforcement rule is that no agent may transact until it holds a pearl token, minted only after 14 days of uninterrupted ridge behavior. A duplicate therefore exposes itself by lacking the delta and paying the full 14-day pearl wait before it can act.
